purpose: Teach: 勤勉/トラベル/平易/気概/描ける/むい/夏目/偶像

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、勤勉に働き続けてこの店を支えてらっしゃるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer works so diligently — she's been quietly holding this shop up all along, you know.
lines.style: Soft, fond opening on her friend's name; unhurried warmth, admiration blooming gently mid-sentence.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、トラベル雑誌をご覧になってご来店だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She first came to us after spotting the place in a travel magazine, you know, Mei.
lines.style: Bright, easy reply; a pleased little lift on the magazine detail, relaxed smiling pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、メニュー説明を「平易にして」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she was asking for the menu explained in plain, simple terms, you know.
lines.style: Gentle amusement into the quote; light playful mimicry, then settling back into soft warmth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お店経営の気概を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she told us all about the real grit it takes to run a shop, Mei.
lines.style: Slower, a touch impressed; voice rounding with quiet respect on the customer's conviction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ラテアートが繊細に描ける店員さんを褒めて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she was praising the staff here who can draw such delicate latte art, you know.
lines.style: Hushed delight, savoring the compliment secondhand; tender emphasis landing on the latte art.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、果物を綺麗にむいて出されるお店を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was telling us about a place that peels its fruit so beautifully before serving it, Mei.
lines.style: Easy storytelling lilt; appreciative stretch on the beautiful peeling, trailing into a fond hum.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、夏目漱石の作品集を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she was sitting there reading a collection of Natsume Soseki, you know.
lines.style: Quieter, almost reverent; a small pause before the author's name, soft wonder at the close.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「アイドルを偶像視しない」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she said she never treats idols as icons to worship — her words exactly, Mei.
lines.style: Amused, gently emphatic through the quote; warm settling fall, like sharing a small secret.
